## `neuro.math.atan2`

Static method on `Math`.

> Returns the angle (in radians) between the X axis and the line going through both the origin and the given point.

## Signatures

```ts
atan2(input: { y: number; x: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Math.atan2` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
